brief.title: MySlideAgent capability showcase
brief.audience: Prospective users deciding whether MySlideAgent can make their kind of presentation
brief.goal: Prove by example that one tool produces executive, technical, analytical, creative and strategic slides

direction.concept: Five slides from five different decks. Each speaks the visual language of its genre — a steering-committee dashboard, a night-mode architecture review, an editorial data story, a product keynote, a consulting roadmap — with its own type, palette, density and diagram grammar. The only constant is craft.

slides.message: Project Atlas is on track; GPU capacity is the one risk to the Q2 launch
